mapping_json.fidelity_notes: §B Reowyn ward-burst rider EXERCISED (first of two attestations run-wide): 'Runic Invocation generates massive Ward bursts through Reowyn's Frostguard' — trigger_grammar RIDER with a DEFENSIVE payload (on-cast-of-carrier -> gain overshield), sibling of the §A devotion-proc row. Item-granted, lives at item_alterations layer; never rewrites core skill_geometry (Lightning Blast stays a chain projectile). Reowyn rider is the RUNEMASTER variant; the mapped core is the Sorcerer caster-spam (this kit). Spark Charge cascade (skill procs charges from itself + Fragment of the Enigma) = a proc-loop rider on cast; engine chain geometry carries the delivery, the Spark-Charge proc-engine is the rider the engine approximates. §0 near-miss: shock WANTED (lightning + 'electrify' in claim) but claim_text is INADMISSIBLE and no fetched behavioral status language exists — WITHHELD.

spine.mech_note: prov=lb;kb. mech_note ref: 'The chain-lightning perennial — tree paths for chains, forks, and repeat-cast storms, currently wearing the Runemaster's [optimization layer].'
